what: Provenance of the canonical artifact set under generated/ (spec + three implementations).
how_produced: Outputs of the two-prompt pipeline (pipeline/prompts/ via pipeline/run.py), iteratively refined and frozen once they passed the conformance oracle. They are the replay (offline) half of the live/replay duality: a live run regenerates a fresh set under generated/.live/ together with its own machine-written PROVENANCE.json (backend, model, UTC timestamp, prompt SHA-256 hashes, files, token usage).

machine_readable_handoff.note: the only RV-format input Prompt #2 receives

oracle: conformance/: 21 language-neutral cases + golden values. Every implementation (canonical or freshly generated) is accepted only if it reproduces all deterministic golden values within an absolute 1e-9 and passes the statistical sampling tolerances. evidence/EVIDENCE.md is the generated 3x21 cross-language matrix.

regenerate.backends: Claude Code CLI (subscription auth) or the Anthropic API via ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (--backend api)
